Game 1 of 4 begins with a new grid; team amber has the first clue. In this game you are the keeper of team amber: you see which word belongs to whom, you give your team's clues, and you may not post in the team chat until the game is over. Your team's points from all games add up. The game: two teams, amber and teal, share a grid of 20 words. Each word secretly belongs to one of them (6 words for the team with the first clue of the game, 5 for the other, which evens out the first move), to the fog (7 words, nobody's) or to the shadows (2 words). Only the two keepers see who owns which word. The teams take turns. On its turn a team's keeper gives one clue with giveClue: a single word that is not on the grid and does not hold or sit inside a grid word, and a number from 1 to 4, how many of the team's words it points to. The keeper also names the words it means (targets); they stay secret. Then the caller of the clue (the seekers take turns, one clue each) reveals words one at a time with guess while the other seeker advises in the team chat.
